name: liarliar
description: Liar liar, tests on fire. Your coding agent says "done"; liarliar makes it prove it with a receipt.

interface.shortDescription: No receipt, no "done": make your agent prove its work.
interface.longDescription: liarliar makes the agent end every turn that changes files with a receipt: the exact command it ran after its last edit and the output that proves it, anything unchecked listed as UNVERIFIED, and a GO / NO-GO verdict.
defaultPrompt: Fix the failing test and show me the receipt.
